name: Mitsubishi Electric ducted system
tagline: Concealed ducted heating and cooling for the whole home, with optional zoning.
summary: Mitsubishi Electric ducted air conditioning uses an indoor unit concealed in the ceiling to deliver warm or cool air through discreet outlets around the home.
The range runs from 2.5 kW bulkhead units to 24.5 kW ceiling-concealed models, and an optional zone controller manages up to 8 zones.

image.alt: Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit and outdoor unit

highlights.title: Whole-home comfort
highlights.text: A central system hidden in the ceiling cavity or bulkhead, with only subtle diffusers and grilles visible.

highlights.title: Up to 8 zones
highlights.text: An optional zone controller directs air to 4 or 8 zones, so unoccupied rooms are not conditioned.

highlights.title: Impressively quiet
highlights.text: SEZ Series 25 and 35 models operate at a hushed 23 dBA.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi and voice control
highlights.text: An optional Wi-Fi adapter adds app control, plus Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant voice control.

highlights.title: Built for extremes
highlights.text: Selected models have a guaranteed cooling operating range of -5°C to 52°C outdoors.

highlights.title: Two-piece indoor units
highlights.text: PEA-M HAA and LAA units separate into two pieces for easier installation in the roof space.
